criteria.name: Major
criteria.description: Agent A makes claim “c” to Agent B supported by analogy “a”

criteria.name: Minor 1
criteria.description: Analogy “a” equates situations that differ in relevant respects

criteria.name: Minor 2
criteria.description: A benefits from B accepting the analogy as valid

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Analogy “a” should be scrutinised for false equivalence

criteria.name: CQ1
criteria.description: What are the relevant similarities between the source of analogy and target claim?

criteria.name: CQ2
criteria.description: What relevant differences weaken the analogy?

criteria.name: CQ3
criteria.description: Does A have a record of relying on weak analogies or false equivalences?

criteria.name: CQ4
criteria.description: What benefit does A derive if B accepts the analogy?
